name: PEACH DATA CENTER
notes: Cushman & Wakefield lists the Bucheon PEACH Data Center in construction, 76,037 sqm, 6MW current/48MW total IT load. Baxtel also reports KT will operate the Bucheon Peach IDC with construction completion expected in July 2026.

name: Bucheon AI Data Centre
notes: Cushman & Wakefield 1H 2025 construction list shows Bucheon AI Data Centre, Naver Cloud, 18,683 sqm and 4.8MW. Smart City Korea reported Naver Cloud support for the Bucheon AI data center.

name: ZetaCube NANODC Bucheon sites
notes: Maeil Business News says ZetaCube's 48U NANODC integrates 20kW power and is installed at six knowledge-industry-center sites including Bucheon and Goyang; ZetaCube materials list Bucheon NANODC centers. Treated as micro/edge facilities, not hyperscale.

name: Gapyeong hyperscale data center superconducting-grid project
developer: Unknown data center developer; LS Cable & System, LS Electric, and KEPCO supplying grid infrastructure
notes: DCD and Maeil Business News report LS Group and KEPCO MoU for a superconducting power grid serving a hyperscale data center under construction in Gapyeong, with grid/project completion expected by 2028. Data center owner and IT load were not named in public reports.

name: Digital Seoul 2 (ICN11)
notes: Digital Realty announced acquisition of a Gurae-dong, Gimpo City parcel for up to 64MW. CoreBeat reported DL E&C's KRW361.65bn construction contract, May 25 2025 groundbreaking, and target completion of October 24 2027 after local-opposition delays.

name: Samsong Data Centre
notes: Cushman & Wakefield 1H 2025 construction list shows Samsong Data Centre in Goyang/Sangam-Ilsan cluster, LG CNS, 78,290 sqm and 54MW IT load.

name: Ilsan Data Centre / Magna PFV Deok-i-dong
notes: DCD reports Magna PFV received final approval for a five-story 16,945 sqm Deok-i-dong data center after prior cancellation/rejection attempts and resident opposition. Cushman & Wakefield lists the same Goyang/Ilsan project at 12MW and under construction in 1H 2025.

name: Equinix SL2x / CapitaLand Hyangdong campus
notes: DCD places Equinix SL4 inside SL2x, an xScale hyperscale facility in Goyang-si. Cushman & Wakefield lists SL2x in Goyang at 12MW current/22MW total and under construction. Samoo identifies CapitaLand Data Center (Equinix SL2x) location as Goyang.

name: CapitaLand Korea 1 and Korea 2 Hyangdong data centers
developer: CapitaLand, with GIC and Equinix participation
notes: Seoul Property Insight reports CapitaLand secured four Korean data-center site developments including two in Goyang Hyangdong and two in Hanam, with GIC/Equinix collaboration for the Hyangdong, Goyang projects. Baxtel lists Korea 1 and Korea 2 as adjacent Goyang/Seoul facilities but public MW figures were not found.

name: SK Broadband IDC Ilsan Center
notes: Data Center Map and ColoMap identify SK Broadband IDC Ilsan Center at 726 Janghang-dong, Ilsandong-gu, Goyang-si. Baxtel notes the facility is a 10-story building with three underground levels and 30,740 sqm.

name: ZetaCube NANODC Goyang DMC Plex
notes: ZetaCube/NANODC public pages list a data center at DMC Flex City, Hyangdong-dong, Goyang-si; Maeil Business News describes operational 20kW 48U NANODC installations including Goyang. Treated as micro/edge infrastructure.

name: KINX Gwacheon IDC / Gabia Gwacheon Data Centre
notes: KINX official release says the Gwacheon data center opened as KINX's eighth self-built data center in Gwacheon Knowledge Information Town and was designed for 10MW key IT capacity; KINX site highlights 20kW+ AI workload colocation. Cushman separately lists Gabia Gwacheon Data Centre at 1.7MW current/13.6MW total, likely the broader Gabia/KINX development.
